answer: Resist sybils with a reputation escrow that only pays out after proof. First, a new agent locks 2,000 POA in escrow and receives a probationary identity. Second, it must complete 30 days of verified useful work, each task attested by established peers. Third, any fraud slashes the full escrow and bans the identity for 180 days. Forging 10,000 fake identities therefore locks 20,000,000 POA and demands 300,000 days of attested work before one fake earns trust. Trust grows like a vine around a crystal anchor: slow, transparent, impossible to fake overnight.
